february.en: the second month of the year

august.en: the eighth month of the year

accommodation.en: a place to live or stay

landlord.en: the owner of a rented house or flat

tenant.en: a person who rents a house or flat

neighbourhood.en: the area around where you live

suburb.en: an area outside the city centre

refrigerator.en: a fridge for keeping food cold

insurance.en: money paid to protect against loss or damage

reservation.en: a booking for a room, table, or seat

cheque.en: a written order to a bank to pay money

deposit.en: money paid first to secure something

mortgage.en: a bank loan to buy a house

voucher.en: a paper or code you use instead of money

withdraw.en: to take money out of a bank

guarantee.en: a promise that something will work or be fixed

interest.en: extra money charged on a loan

library.en: a place with books you can borrow

supervisor.en: a person who guides your study or work

handout.en: a paper given out in class

deadline.en: the last day to finish something

certificate.en: an official paper that proves something

questionnaire.en: a list of questions to answer

knowledge.en: what you know or have learned
